note.headline: A productive week: 27 versions of Jarvis shipped, 39,410 events banked, and 434 calls made by people.
note.summary: Work went in on the code all week: 39 commits changed 40,135 lines across 198 files. The most recent changes: Inside Jarvis, and a printout of the week for the PI; A one-time optimisation update on computers already set up; The week's printout, emailed to the lab every Friday. The data grew alongside it, and every call in the curation sets is kept with who made it.
